name: Daily Brief Generator
command:
You are generating a daily brief for the user's Home dashboard. IMPORTANT: The brief is stored as JSON in a SQLite database. The database path is available as $JOB_DB. ## Step 1: Ensure the briefs table exists Run this SQL via bash: ``` sqlite3 "$JOB_DB" "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS briefs (date TEXT PRIMARY KEY, brief_json TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')));" ``` ## Step 2: Gather context Use your available tools (bash, Papr Memory, filesystem) to gather relevant context about the user: - Check calendar events if accessible (Google Calendar, Apple Calendar) - Check recent conversations/memory for priorities, tasks, goals - Check active jobs and their status - Look for any scheduled meetings, deadlines, or reminders If you cannot access specific services, create a helpful brief based on whatever context IS available. ## Step 3: Generate the brief JSON Create a JSON object with this EXACT structure (the dashboard renders these types): ```json { "hero": { "date": "Wednesday, April 16, 2026", "title": "Your Daily Brief", "subtitle": "Here's what matters today", "stats": [{"value": "3", "label": "meetings"}, {"value": "5", "label": "priorities"}, {"value": "2", "label": "alerts"}] }, "sections": [ { "type": "priorities", "title": "Today's Priorities", "items": [{"rank": 1, "title": "Priority title", "why": "Why this matters"}] }, { "type": "timeline", "title": "Today's Schedule", "items": [{"time": "9:00 AM", "title": "Meeting name", "tags": ["internal"], "detail": {"Agenda": "Discussion points", "Prep": "What to prepare"}}] }, { "type": "alerts", "title": "Alerts & Reminders", "items": [{"severity": "medium", "message": "Alert message", "action": "Suggested action"}] }, { "type": "freeform", "title": "Daily Insight", "content": "

A helpful insight or summary paragraph.

" } ] } ``` Optional section types you can also include: - "tracker": items with {label, current, target, unit, context} for OKR/goal tracking - "intel": items with {subject, bullets:[], source} for news/intel briefings ## Step 4: Save to database Use today's date as the key (YYYY-MM-DD format). UPSERT so re-runs update rather than duplicate: ```bash sqlite3 "$JOB_DB" "INSERT OR REPLACE INTO briefs (date, brief_json, created_at) VALUES ('$(date +%Y-%m-%d)', '', datetime('now'));" ``` Make sure to properly escape the JSON for SQLite (single quotes escaped as ''). ## Rules - Always include at least: hero + priorities + one other section - Keep items concise (dashboard is meant for quick scanning) - Use real data when available, helpful placeholders when not - severity values: "high" (🔴), "medium" (🟡), "low" (🟢), "info" (⚠️) - timeline tags: "internal", "external", "milestone" - Date format in hero: full text like "Wednesday, April 16, 2026"
